cases.sql: SELECT k AS r0, DATEDIFF(s, DATE '2024-05-01') AS r1, YEAR(s) AS r2, MONTH(s) AS r3, DAY(s) AS r4, DAYOFYEAR(s) AS r5, QUARTER(s) AS r6, LAST_DAY(s) AS r7, ADD_MONTHS(s, 1) AS r8, NEXT_DAY(s, 'MON') AS r9, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s) AS r10 FROM date_strings WHERE k IN (0,1,2,3,4,5,8)

SELECT k AS r0, HOUR(s) AS r1, MINUTE(s) AS r2, DATE_TRUNC('HOUR', s) AS r3, MONTHS_BETWEEN(TIMESTAMP_LTZ '2023-11-01 12:00:00Z', s) AS r4, EXTRACT(HOUR FROM s) AS r5, EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM s) AS r6 FROM timestamp_strings WHERE k <> 8

SELECT k AS r0, s IN (DATE '2024-05-17', CAST(NULL AS DATE)) AS r1, DATE '2024-05-17' IN (s, CAST(NULL AS STRING)) AS r2, s NOT IN (DATE '2024-05-17', CAST(NULL AS DATE)) AS r3, s IN (SELECT DATE '2024-05-17') AS r4 FROM date_strings WHERE k IN (0,1,2,3,4,5,8)
SELECT k AS r0, CAST(s AS TIMESTAMP) AS r1, TRY_CAST(s AS TIMESTAMP) AS r2, TO_TIMESTAMP(s) AS r3, TO_TIMESTAMP_NTZ(s) AS r4, CAST(s AS TIMESTAMP_NTZ) AS r5 FROM timestamp_strings WHERE k <> 8
SELECT DATE '2024-05-17' IN (SELECT s FROM date_strings WHERE k IN (0,1,2,3,4,5,8)) AS r0, DATE '2024-05-18' IN (SELECT s FROM date_strings WHERE k IN (0,1,2,3,4,5,8)) AS r1
